hero.title: The ChatShack C.I.C.
hero.lede1: A peer-led mental health support community for adults aged 18+.
hero.lede2: A safe, confidential and non-judgemental place to talk, connect, find support and explore the next step.

about.heading: What is The ChatShack?
about.tagline: A place where you can talk.
about.intro: The ChatShack C.I.C. is a peer-led mental health support community created around a simple belief:
about.belief: Nobody should have to face difficult times alone.
about.paragraph1: We provide a welcoming community where adults can meet others, talk openly, build connections and access appropriate support.
about.paragraph2: We are not here to judge you, tell you how you should feel or make assumptions about your circumstances.
about.paragraph3: We're here to listen, support and help you find the right next step.

cards.title: CONNECT
cards.desc: Meet people and become part of a community.

cards.title: SUPPORT
cards.desc: Peer support, groups, activities and individual support.

cards.title: ACCESS
cards.desc: Help finding appropriate professional services and treatment when needed.

promise.heading: Our Promise
promise.note: You don't have to have all the answers before you come through the door.

crisis.heading: Need help today?
crisis.paragraph1: The ChatShack aims to provide a 1st Point of Contact for people experiencing mental-health difficulties.
crisis.paragraph2: Where appropriate and where available, we can help people navigate towards same-day support and treatment.
crisis.paragraph3: If we can't provide what you need ourselves, our Directory of Partners & Resources helps connect you with organisations that may be able to help.
crisis.emergencyTitle: IN AN EMERGENCY OR IMMEDIATE DANGER
crisis.emergencyNote: or go to your nearest A&E department.

community.heading: Our Community
community.subheading: MORE THAN A GROUP. A COMMUNITY.
community.paragraph: The ChatShack isn't just about sitting in a room and talking. Our community can include:
items: Support for people who may find traditional services difficult to access
community.quote: "Nobody should have to face difficult times alone."

partners.heading: Partners & Resources
partners.subheading: WE DON'T HAVE TO DO IT ALL OURSELVES.
partners.paragraph1: The ChatShack is building a Community of Like-Minded Communities. We work bringing together trusted organisations, professionals, community groups and resources across mental health, wellbeing and wider social support.
partners.paragraph2: If we can't help, one of our partners may be able to.

donate.heading: Together we can make a bigger difference.
donate.paragraph: Your donation helps us keep our services free and available for everyone who needs them.
